# WRD Media

> WRD Media is the practice behind Howard Kan, a fractional CMO for established trade and home-service businesses in Frisco, Texas, DFW, and remote across the US. One engagement covers marketing strategy and direction, AI search visibility (Ascend), and 3D sales tools (Envision), run by Howard directly. Advisor is $4,999 a month and Embedded is $9,999 a month, with a 90-day initial term and 3 clients at a time.

## The engagement
- [Fractional CMO: tiers, what is included, terms](https://wrdmedia.com/services/)
- [Ascend: AI visibility and SEO/GEO, included in the engagement](https://wrdmedia.com/services/ai-answer-visibility/)
- [Envision: 3D sales tools, included in the engagement](https://wrdmedia.com/services/3d-sales-tools/)
- [Architect: CMO strategy and direction, included in the engagement](https://wrdmedia.com/services/marketing-director/)
- [AI phone assistants: provided inside Embedded engagements when they fit](https://wrdmedia.com/services/ai-phone-assistants/)
